full_judgment: 29. In cross-examination by accused Abul Kalam, this witness stated that the land he working, the land of that land is 3/4 gandas. He cannot say the dag and khatian of the land. His son Moju was working at the field. Osman and Abul Hossain arc of the same residence. The land is in the South of the house of accused Osman. The house of Mannar, Isahak and Fazfur Rahman are to the East from the house of accused Osman. In that house the 4/5 inhabitants. Towards North of the house of Osman, the houses of Mokhlesur Rahman, Fazal Rahman, Fakir Islam, Ali Ahmed, Malek Sawdagor and others Rail line is 200/300 cubits East of the house of Osman. The house of Habibullah is to the East of rail line, which is 600 yards from the house of accused Osman. His son was working in the field, which is West of the house of Md. Habibullah. Kazipara road is East to West in length. The shop of Halim is adjacent to the North of Kazipara road there is no house on the North of the shop. To the West of the road is Halda irrigation prosecution. A South facing drain for pouring water from the said project is there. The sides of the drain are high. It is true that East side of the said drain is road. It is true that to go to Swandip Para from Kazipara road one has to go by the South through the project. Hazi Fakir road after passing Swandipara by the East joint Nazirhat rail line. To the North of the Kazipara road in the brickfield. At the time of occurrence season was dry. That was not the time for buying and selling of bricks. Bricks are sold through out the year. At that time bricks were paled in lines. At that time mud were also heaped. There is a room of manager. Labour barrack and office but those are empty. The house of Habilder Abdul Malek on the South of Kazipara road. He could not remember whether he stated to investigating officer that the accused went on to the road by his side. He did not stated to the investigating officer that while the accused passing by him and while he made a question then the accused replied that if he raised any alarm then he will be shot at. He could not recollect whether he stated to the investigating officer that enmity crept .out for apprehending Alamgir. Abdul Motaleb the informant is the witness of the case. He denied the suggestion that in that arms case victim Abul Kashem was not a witness. He cannot say whether in that case Alagmir got acquittal. He denied the suggestion that Abdul Gafur is uncle of informant. He (Gafur) is the father-in-law of him. He denied the suggestion that he is the husband of the cousin sister of the informant He denied the suggestion that at the time of occurrence he was not present while his son cutting earth the borga land or the accused did not bye pass him with arms or accused Kalam did not inflicted blows on the deceased or that he had know kirich in his hand or that Kalam is not in any way involved in the incident or he deposed falsely.
